hooks.name: original_born_boundary
hooks.proposed_action: Retain ordinary call; snapshot IEEE entry for nonfinite fallback, reset call-local certificates before early exits. Nonfinite Born branches to staged C/first-QP preparation before REF-dependent work.

hooks.name: reference_update
hooks.proposed_action: Publish a checked contiguous Born buffer into the strided ANS row; keep REF=sum(Born(1:NSQSO_BORN)). Refresh for finite-Born QP rescue too.

hooks.name: ordinary_mp_resets
hooks.proposed_action: Preserve any current-call staged C across these resets; set MP_PS_SET only after successful adoption. Never set MP_DONE or MP_DONE_ONCE for preparation/Born work.

hooks.name: qp_policy_entry
hooks.proposed_action: For every selected QP library, resolve the integrand policy outside the MP_PS_SET guard and before any MP_DONE/reuse test. First adoption/policy change refreshes Born and starts a fresh QP stability cohort (result slots, EVAL_DONE, STAB_INDEX); historical cohorts are diagnostic only.

hooks.name: qp_coordinate_entry
hooks.proposed_action: Prepare/adopt C only once. Keep CTMode0 and unsupported formats on explicit legacy setter path. Failure uses initialized-stage cleanup and rejected output.

hooks.name: qp_backend_reuse_shortcut
hooks.proposed_action: Recheck the selected policy before the zero-rotation GOTO300 shortcut (which bypasses label205 and numerator generation). If the policy changed, route through staging and recomputation with MP_DONE false; preserve same-policy direction/reuse shortcuts.

hooks.name: host_initialization_commit
hooks.proposed_action: Nonfinite-Born preparation failures occur before this counter/filter publication. Use validity flags for threshold/bypass/rotation snapshots; do not jump blindly to final cleanup with uninitialized state/backend identity.

hooks.name: actual_numerator_completion
hooks.proposed_action: Existing calls remain actual completion boundaries. Invalidate MP_DONE and coefficient-reuse state on policy/view change; do not fabricate completion.

hooks.name: rotation
hooks.proposed_action: Use fixed MP_PS=C for every rotation, preserve current MP_P view and cache resets. No second phase-space repair.

hooks.anchor: C Make sure that we finish by emptying caches
hooks.name: failure_cleanup
hooks.proposed_action: Restore only initialized threshold/rotation/bypass snapshots and relevant caches, then finalize rejected accuracy1/invalid output. Do not let CHECKPHASE overwrite a preparation-failure rejection or access an uninitialized backend identity.

hooks.name: integrand_policy
hooks.proposed_action: One generated policy predicate shared with effective-Born staging; preserve all existing UseQPIntegrand flags and actual selected-library identity.

hooks.name: model_sync
hooks.proposed_action: The true Born evaluator uses the existing MP model after the same synchronization contract. No decimal reparse or blanket promotion of DP parameters.

hooks.name: rounded_view
hooks.proposed_action: False integrand option retains rounded DP coordinate/numerator view; published Born/reference must match it. QP tensor and mass policies remain independently reported.

hooks.name: born_graph
hooks.proposed_action: Reuse the copied Born graph/color/split-order data to emit a stateless precision-specific aggregate with generated HELAS calls, flavor, polarization, averaging and selections. No fixture dimensions or shared waveform scratch.

hooks.name: split_born_learning
hooks.proposed_action: Generate a narrowly supported transaction for private saved Born learning state: successful finite calls retain exact existing updates; failed nonfinite attempts restore entry NTRY/GOODHEL/HELRESET/selection state. Host cleanup cannot access these saved locals.

hooks.name: unsplit_born_learning
hooks.proposed_action: Apply the same generated transaction to the ordinary Born template without changing successful finite calls or unsupported exports. Validate selection/learning equivalence through source fixtures before native tests.

hooks.anchor: C Report to the user or update the PS point.
hooks.name: repair_outcome
hooks.proposed_action: Render a checked sibling preserving the existing numerical body and explicit primary/alternate errors. Copy output only on actual success; a finite retained input is not success.

interfaces.adoption: ADOPT_EFFECTIVE_CONTEXT(..., CONTEXT_CHANGED, OK); call-local readiness distinct from numerator completion; update host arrays/REF atomically.
interfaces.born: EFFECTIVE_BORN(C128, C8, INTEGRAND_POLICY, USERHEL, FLAV_IDX, BORN(0:NSQSO_BORN), OK); stateless generated aggregate, no loop scratch mutation.
interfaces.checked_repair: PREPARE_EFFECTIVE_POINT(P_USER, C128, C8, ERR_PRIMARY, ERR_ALTERNATE, OK); same model and repair arithmetic, explicit success.
interfaces.cleanup: Current-call rejected state survives normal cleanup; precision return digits describe actual loop work only.

no_accuracy_claim: Coordinate/normalization alignment does not resolve scalar/tensor accuracy or the separate default stability estimator limitation.
reason: Reviewable implementation plan. Checked-repair and generated stateless Born bodies must be implemented together; these hooks alone are not executable changes.
supported: scalar optimized on-shell SM Born with direct interference reduction
